purpose: Replace an arbitrary fixed AOD-age cutoff with a deterministic same-twilight-transition AERONET anchor plus continuous co-located MPLNET temporal bridge, using conservative interval propagation and independent cloud/glare vetoes before target radiance opening.

absoluteAodAnchor.source: AERONET Version 3 Solar AOD Level 2.0 at Izana
absoluteAodAnchor.aod550Conversion: derive from the admitted AERONET spectral AOD and Angstrom information using the exact pre-frozen conversion/uncertainty method; never fit to Pandora radiance
absoluteAodAnchor.anchorSelectionEvening: nearest quality-assured solar Level-2 observation on the illuminated side of the same local sunset transition before the target twilight record
absoluteAodAnchor.anchorSelectionMorning: nearest quality-assured solar Level-2 observation on the illuminated side of the same local sunrise transition after the target twilight record

temporalBridge.source: NASA MPLNET Version 3 AER at Izana
temporalBridge.role: propagate aerosol-column evolution from the AERONET absolute anchor time to the target twilight time without treating MPLNET as an independent second absolute truth
temporalBridge.dependency: MPLNET AER uses sun/lunar photometer AOD information in its calibration/retrieval chain; its absolute errors must not be combined with AERONET as independent Gaussian evidence
requiredAtAnchorAndTarget: quality-admitted AER product sample or product averaging interval
AOD plus product-reported AOD uncertainty/error field
wavelength/Angstrom information sufficient for a pre-frozen conversion to AOD550 or an explicitly bounded 532-to-550 conversion
temporalBridge.continuityRule: the sequence of admitted MPLNET product intervals from the anchor through the target must have no missing gap greater than two times the nominal averaging interval/cadence declared by the exact product metadata; derive the gap limit from that product metadata rather than inventing a fixed clock-minute threshold
temporalBridge.profileStabilityRule: reject if the admitted AER/NRB metadata show a discontinuous aerosol-layer/profile/depolarization regime transition that invalidates a single continuous bridge under the separately frozen classifier

intervalPropagation.anchor: construct a closed AERONET AOD550 interval from the pre-frozen source-instrument plus spectral-conversion uncertainty method
intervalPropagation.mplnetSamples: construct closed AOD550 intervals at anchor and target from the exact MPLNET product value/error fields and the pre-frozen wavelength conversion method
intervalPropagation.bridgeUncertainty: use conservative interval arithmetic: add the AERONET anchor interval to the full interval of (MPL target - MPL anchor); do not reduce width by assuming AERONET/MPLNET independence or undocumented covariance
intervalPropagation.additionalRepresentativeness: any separately documented spatial/vertical/temporal representativeness bound is Minkowski-added to the interval before admission

cloudQc.principle: clear-sky admission is independent of Pandora target radiance

mplnet.rule: reject if a quality-admitted cloud detection/contamination interval overlaps the target exposure or its instrument timing-uncertainty interval

sona.rule: require independently usable all-sky images/cloud products bracketing the target; each bracketing record must lie within one nominal SONA product cadence of the target, where cadence is taken from the exact metadata snapshot rather than fitted from outcomes

cloudQc.combined: a cloud/glare rejection from either independent QC path rejects the observation; a missing/ambiguous required QC path does not become clear by default

externalBindingsStillRequiredBeforeExecu: exact AERONET per-channel/Angstrom uncertainty conversion method applicable to the selected product
exact MPLNET AER value/error/QA field semantics and wavelength conversion method for the selected product version
exact MPLNET nominal averaging/cadence metadata used by the continuity rule
exact SONA product/image cadence and directional cloud/glare classification method
any required aerosol profile/depolarization regime classifier thresholds, frozen from external method evidence
